name: com.humanbodycalculator/health-calculators
title: Human Body Calculator MCP
description: 51 free health calculators for BMI, BMR, TDEE, nutrition, body fat, pregnancy and wellness.

tools.name: list_health_calculators
tools.description: List all 51 supported health calculator types with required inputs, conditional unit rules, allowed enums, and valid numeric ranges. Informational estimate only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional.

type.description: Optional calculator type to inspect a single schema.

tools.name: run_health_calculator
tools.description: Execute any of the 51 Human Body Calculator computations statelessly without authentication using its type key and input object. Informational estimate only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional.

type.description: Calculator key (e.g. bmi, bmr, tdee, calorie_needs, body_fat).

inputs.description: Input fields matching the selected calculator schema.

tools.name: calculate_bmi
tools.description: Compute Body Mass Index (weight_kg / height_m^2) and WHO weight classification (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese I-III). Supports cm/m/ft height and kg/lbs weight. Informational estimate only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional.

gender.description: Biological sex / gender category used by formula ("male", "female", or "other").

height.description: Body height in heightUnit (50-300 cm equivalent). Omit when heightUnit="ft" and supply feet/inches instead.

weight.description: Body weight in weightUnit (1-500 kg equivalent).

tools.name: calculate_bai
tools.description: Estimate body fat percentage without body weight using Bergman BAI formula: (hip_cm / height_m^1.5) - 18 with ACE gender classification. Informational estimate only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional.

gender.description: Biological sex / gender category used by formula ("male", "female", or "other").

height.description: Body height in heightUnit (50-300 cm equivalent). Omit when heightUnit="ft" and supply feet/inches instead.

hip.description: Hip circumference in hipUnit (40-250 cm equivalent). Required in calculate_body_fat when gender is "female" or "other".

tools.name: calculate_body_fat
tools.description: Estimate body fat percentage using the U.S. Navy circumference equations (Hodgdon & Beckett). Conditional: "hip" is required when gender is "female" or "other". Informational estimate only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional.
